demo.enterprise_ai_dashboard_visite_guidee_3_: Enterprise AI Dashboard · Guided tour · 3 to 5 minutes
demo.decouvrez_les_parcours_reels_du_produit_: Explore the product’s real workflows. This tour does not upload files, send prompts, submit forms or make AI calls.
demo.schema_de_lecture_sans_resultat_simule_n: An explanatory diagram, with no simulated results or implied execution order. Actions are triggered in the actual features.
demo.nouvel_onglet_cette_etape_reste_ouverte_: New tab · this step stays open here
demo.prevision_des_couts_ia_disponible_dans_l: AI cost forecasting · available in the Dashboard, depending on history and configured pricing.
demo.appel_ia_en_direct_potentiellement_requi: A live AI call may be required
demo.la_confirmation_est_declaree_par_vous_au: Confirmation is your declaration. This tour does not mark any action as technically verified.
demo.les_etapes_et_confirmations_restent_temp: Steps and confirmations remain temporarily in this tab. Guided Demo does not store prompts, files or business results.
demo.les_equipes_veulent_exploiter_leurs_docu: Teams want to use their documents and automate forms while keeping track of model performance and costs.
demo.cette_demonstration_suit_des_parcours_an: This demo follows existing Angular and Express workflows. Answers and measurements shown by the features come from their actual services; this tour fabricates no data.
demo.parcourez_les_six_etapes_l_etat_de: Explore the six steps. Tour state stays in this tab and is not saved on the server.
demo.avoir_consulte_les_objectifs_et_les_limi: Review the demo’s objectives and limitations.
demo.une_equipe_peut_rendre_un_document_inter: A team can make a document searchable without copying it into every question.
demo.le_generator_accepte_un_pdf_ou_un: The Generator accepts a PDF or text file. The server extracts and splits the text, then stores chunks and their lexical SQLite FTS5 index. Retrieval can be limited to the active document. No vector embeddings are used.
demo.ouvrez_le_generator_dans_un_nouvel_ongle: Open the Generator in a new tab. If you choose to try ingestion, use a non-sensitive file and check the actual result before confirming this step. The demo uploads no files.
demo.avoir_ouvert_le_generator_et_si_un: Open the Generator and, if you voluntarily uploaded a document, verify its result there.
demo.interroger_le_document_avec_ses_sources: Ask about a document with sources
demo.les_collaborateurs_peuvent_poser_une_que: Users can ask a focused question and examine the document passages associated with the answer.
demo.le_serveur_recupere_lexicalement_des_chu: The server retrieves chunks lexically using SQLite FTS5, applies the selected document scope and sends context to Groq. The answer may include source references. Validation checks the identity of retrieved labels, not factual accuracy or entailment.
demo.dans_le_generator_ouvert_saisissez_vous_: In the open Generator, enter a question about your document yourself. A Groq request is triggered only when you send it in the existing chat.
demo.avoir_envoye_explicitement_une_question_: Explicitly send a question and examine the answer and references in the chat; confirm only if you actually did so.
demo.transformer_une_demande_en_formulaire: Turn a request into a form
demo.une_demande_en_langage_naturel_peut_deve: A natural-language request can become an input form tailored to a business process.
demo.le_chat_transmet_la_demande_a_la: The chat sends the request to the dedicated generation route. Groq returns a structured schema that Angular renders as a reactive form. This workflow does not automatically trigger RAG retrieval.
demo.dans_le_generator_demandez_explicitement: In the Generator, explicitly request a form. Inspect the generated form, but do not submit it with personal data.
demo.avoir_demande_explicitement_un_formulair: Explicitly request a form and verify that a schema was rendered, without submitting data.
demo.les_equipes_d_exploitation_ont_besoin_de: Operations teams need to understand latency, model usage and the approximate costs.
demo.le_dashboard_peut_afficher_la_latence_le: The Dashboard can display latency, provider-reported input and output tokens, estimated costs and metadata-only history. Costs use configured pricing and are not actual billed amounts. Telemetry is local and depends on server demo configuration; otherwise the interface must indicate that measurements are unavailable.
demo.ouvrez_le_dashboard_dans_un_nouvel_ongle: Open the Dashboard in a new tab and observe its actual state. It may show metrics or indicate that local telemetry is not enabled.
demo.avoir_consulte_le_dashboard_et_constate_: Review the Dashboard and determine whether local metrics are available.
demo.la_valeur_vient_de_parcours_concrets_str: Value comes from concrete workflows: structuring requests, searching documents and making AI usage understandable to teams.
demo.le_produit_associe_angular_19_une_api: The product combines Angular 19, an Express API, Groq and SQLite: form generation, PDF RAG with source references and operational observability. AI calls require an explicit action in the existing features.
demo.faites_le_bilan_des_capacites_presentes_: Review the available capabilities and distinguish them from future plans.
demo.avoir_parcouru_les_capacites_livrees_et_: Review delivered capabilities and identify what remains planned.
demo.oui_seulement_apres_votre_action_explici: Yes · only after your explicit action in the feature.
demo.non_cette_etape_ne_necessite_pas_d: No · this step does not require an AI call.

architecture.explorez_les_flux_reels_du_systeme: Explore the system’s real data flows
architecture.une_carte_interactive_des_parcours_reell: An interactive map of existing workflows: form generation, lexical PDF retrieval, local observability and the internal tool engine (no UI).
architecture.les_n_uds_et_connexions_sont_mis: Nodes and connections are highlighted for the selected workflow.
architecture.schema_architectural_du_flux_selectionne: Architecture diagram of the selected workflow; horizontal scrolling available
architecture.selectionnez_un_n_ud_au_clic_ou: Select a node by clicking, or use Tab then Enter/Space, or the left/right arrows. Arrows show documented connections, with no implied execution order. Full descriptions are available below.
architecture.composants_et_connexions_du_flux_selecti: Components and connections in the selected workflow
architecture.description_textuelle_accessible_du_diag: Accessible text description of the diagram
architecture.prevision_des_couts_ia_et_simulation_bud: AI cost forecasting and budget simulation
architecture.moteur_interne_a_outils_de_lecture_seule: Internal read-only tool engine · no UI
architecture.questions_rag_et_generation_de_schemas_d: RAG questions and form schema generation.
architecture.le_chat_conserve_le_document_actif_envoi: The chat retains the active document, sends the chosen scope and displays answers, citations and execution details. Form generation is a separate workflow.
architecture.rendu_du_schema_json_retourne_par_la: Renders the JSON schema returned by AI generation.
architecture.le_schema_de_formulaire_est_rendu_dans: Angular renders the form schema, which is then submitted separately. Generation does not automatically trigger RAG retrieval.
architecture.presentation_des_metriques_et_historique: Displays metrics and history authorized for the local demo.
architecture.le_dashboard_lit_des_agregats_series_exe: The dashboard reads aggregates, series, executions, documents and submission metadata. Telemetry endpoints are restricted to local demo mode.
architecture.demande_a_groq_un_schema_json_de: Requests a JSON form schema from Groq.
architecture.le_serveur_construit_l_instruction_de_ge: The server builds the structured generation instruction and returns the schema to Angular. The current client does not automatically add RAG context.
architecture.persiste_le_payload_soumis_dans_la_table: Persists the submitted payload in the business forms table.
architecture.les_valeurs_sont_stockees_dans_sqlite_le: Values are stored in SQLite. By default, the Dashboard exposes only metadata; the existing submission API still returns data to the submitting client.
architecture.valide_la_portee_recupere_les_chunks_fts: Validates scope, retrieves FTS5 chunks, calls Groq and builds source references.
architecture.la_recherche_est_lexicale_sqlite_fts5_fi: Retrieval uses lexical SQLite FTS5 and can be filtered by documentId. Citation labels identify retrieved sources without proving factual accuracy.
architecture.extrait_le_texte_recu_et_declenche_sa: Extracts incoming text and triggers storage/indexing.
architecture.l_endpoint_de_parsing_retourne_notamment: The parsing endpoint returns documentId, filename, extracted text and chunk count to the client that sent the document.
architecture.valide_le_but_execute_la_boucle_groq: Validates the goal, runs the Groq loop and restricts calls to approved tools.
architecture.le_handler_agent_est_une_voie_independan: The Agent handler is independent of RAG chat. It performs neither FTS5 retrieval nor document citation generation.
architecture.produit_le_schema_json_demande_par_le: Produces the JSON schema requested by the Generator.
architecture.le_modele_utilise_par_la_route_de: The form route’s model is currently configured on the server; this flow does not automatically receive the chat’s active document.
architecture.repond_aux_questions_a_partir_des_passag: Answers questions using retrieved passages and receives source labels.
architecture.l_api_consomme_l_usage_fournisseur_quand: The API consumes provider usage when available. It may use a fallback model; the execution identifies the model actually used.
architecture.choisit_uniquement_parmi_les_operations_: Chooses only from read operations defined by the internal engine retained for reuse.
architecture.le_runner_borne_duree_iterations_et_nomb: The runner limits duration, iterations and call count; unauthorized tool requests are rejected.
architecture.conserve_metadonnees_de_documents_chunks: Stores document metadata, chunks and a persistent lexical index.
architecture.les_chunks_sont_lies_a_un_document: Chunks belong to a document, are searched lexically with FTS5 and are filtered in SQL by documentId when document scope is requested. No vector embeddings are used.
architecture.le_payload_metier_est_conserve_dans_la: Business payloads are stored in the database. They must not be exposed in public architecture or demo views.
architecture.mesure_etapes_duree_totale_usage_fournis: Measures steps, total duration, provider usage and configurable estimated cost.
architecture.les_montants_sont_des_estimations_fondee: Amounts are estimates based on configured pricing, not invoices. Missing usage values remain unavailable.
architecture.persiste_les_seules_metadonnees_de_trace: Persists trace metadata and step durations only.
architecture.l_historique_ne_conserve_pas_prompts_rep: History does not store prompts, responses, document excerpts, payloads, keys or headers.
architecture.compte_les_formulaires_et_lit_un_histori: Counts forms and reads limited history without returning payloads or filenames.
architecture.les_outils_sont_codes_cote_serveur_et: Tools are implemented on the server and do not accept arbitrary SQL. Their output contains authorized metadata only.
architecture.alimente_les_outils_de_lecture_de_l: Provides counters and history metadata to the Agent’s read tools.
architecture.la_voie_agent_lit_les_metadonnees_de: The Agent path reads submission and document metadata; it does not read document contents or form payloads.
architecture.appel_groq_pour_produire_un_schema_json: Groq call to produce a JSON schema.
architecture.groq_retourne_le_schema_json_a_la: Groq returns the JSON schema to the Express route.
architecture.express_retourne_le_schema_que_le_compos: Express returns the schema rendered by the Angular component.
architecture.post_api_chat_avec_le_prompt_et: POST /api/chat with the prompt and optional document scope.
architecture.recherche_lexicale_fts5_avec_filtre_docu: Lexical FTS5 retrieval filtered by documentId when provided.
architecture.passages_retrouves_et_citations_candidat: Retrieved passages and candidate citations sent to Groq.
architecture.groq_retourne_le_texte_et_l_usage: Groq returns text and provider usage to the Express route.
architecture.express_retourne_reponse_labels_valides_: Express returns the answer, validated labels, source references and execution metadata.
architecture.mesure_les_etapes_du_handler_usage_et: Measures handler steps, usage and pricing estimate.
architecture.ecrit_une_trace_metadata_only_et_ses: Writes a metadata-only trace and its ordered steps.
architecture.appel_groq_avec_outils_explicitement_dec: Groq call with explicitly declared tools and execution limits.
architecture.seuls_les_noms_et_arguments_de_la: Only allowlisted names and arguments are executed.
architecture.lectures_bornees_de_compteurs_et_d_histo: Bounded reads of counters and metadata-only history.
architecture.transformer_une_demande_en_schema_de_for: Turn a request into a form schema, then store the submitted values.
architecture.le_chat_detecte_la_demande_de_generation: The chat detects a generation request and sends it to the dedicated route.
architecture.express_sollicite_groq_avec_une_consigne: Express requests a structured JSON response from Groq; generation does not automatically use RAG retrieval.
architecture.le_schema_recu_est_transforme_en_control: The received schema becomes Angular reactive controls.
architecture.a_l_envoi_express_stocke_les_valeurs: On submission, Express stores values in SQLite; this business data remains private.
architecture.retrouver_des_passages_lexicalement_dans: Retrieve passages lexically in a selected document and provide traceable sources.
architecture.angular_transmet_la_question_et_en_mode: Angular sends the question and, in active document mode, its documentId.
architecture.la_requete_fts5_filtre_les_chunks_sur: The FTS5 query filters chunks by the selected document, or searches all documents if that mode is selected.
architecture.les_passages_retrouves_sont_envoyes_a_gr: Retrieved passages are sent to Groq with request-local citation labels.
architecture.le_serveur_valide_que_les_labels_cites: The server checks that cited labels exist among the retrieved sources; this does not prove the answer’s factual accuracy.
architecture.mesurer_les_requetes_rag_et_conserver_un: Measure RAG requests and retain an operational trace without private content.
architecture.le_handler_mesure_la_validation_la_reche: The handler measures validation, retrieval, context preparation and Groq calls.
architecture.les_tokens_viennent_de_l_usage_fournisse: Tokens come from provider usage when available; cost is an estimate based on configured pricing, not an invoice.
architecture.sqlite_conserve_trace_id_statut_scope_co: SQLite stores trace ID, status, scope, counters, nullable usage, estimated costs and ordered durations; no prompt, response or excerpt.
architecture.le_dashboard_agrege_ces_metadonnees_derr: The Dashboard aggregates this metadata behind local demo mode.
architecture.module_backend_local_conserve_pour_5e_sa: Local backend module retained for 5E, without a UI or automatic connection to Support Agent Studio.
architecture.un_appel_technique_local_autorise_peut_t: An authorized local technical call can send a goal to /api/agent/run; this workflow bypasses RAG chat and no longer has a product UI.
architecture.groq_ne_peut_demander_que_le_comptage: Groq can only request submission counts or bounded metadata-only history.
architecture.le_runner_valide_les_noms_arguments_limi: The runner validates names/arguments and limits time, iterations and call count; arbitrary tools are rejected.
architecture.le_backend_retourne_a_l_appelant_techniq: The backend returns the answer and tool trace to the technical caller, without filenames or payloads. Human approval is not implemented yet.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.localNotice: Local tickets stored in plain text in SQLite. No AI calls, human handoff or external notifications. Do not enter secrets.
tickets.listFailed: Tickets unavailable. Check the local server and try again.
tickets.empty: No tickets match these filters. Create a ticket or adjust your search.
tickets.validation: Title and description are required, cannot be blank and must respect the stated limits.
tickets.rulesNotice: Keywords in the title and description determine category and priority. You can correct the result after creation. No confidence score, refund decision or AI call.
tickets.conversationListFailed: Conversation list unavailable. Reload before confirming.
tickets.confirmNotice: These details will be stored in SQLite. Check the content and association before confirming. Copied text remains in the ticket even if the conversation is deleted.
tickets.noLinkedConversation: No linked conversation: created independently or conversation deleted.
tickets.eventsFailed: History unavailable. The ticket is retained; reload its events.
tickets.selectHelp: Inspect its details, conversation and history, or create a support request.
tickets.unsaved: Unsaved ticket: confirm or cancel changes before switching workspace, agent or ticket.
tickets.saved: Changes saved and recorded in history.
tickets.conflict: Conflict or limit reached. Cancel changes and reload. After an uncertain submission, retry the same draft without editing it.
tickets.notFound: Ticket, conversation or message not found for this agent. Reload the data.
tickets.forbidden: Access denied: tickets require local demo mode.
tickets.invalid: Request rejected. Check the fields, limits and linked conversation.
tickets.failed: Operation not confirmed. Your input is retained. To retry creation, keep the same draft to reuse its key; for an update, reload the details before trying again.
tickets.manualReason: Manual choice by the local user.
tickets.ruleReason: Category: {{category}} ({{categoryMatch}}) · priority: {{priority}} ({{priorityMatch}}). Lexical rules, without semantic validation.
tickets.conversationDraft: An unsent message is retained in the current conversation. Send or clear it before opening another conversation from a ticket.
